product_overview: NotFreela is an operational workspace for freelancers that centralizes clients, projects, tasks, documents and finances into a single interface to reduce fragmentation and improve operational visibility.
core_goals: Provide a single integrated workspace for project, task, client and financial management for freelancers
Reduce tool fragmentation by centralizing core operational workflows (projects, tasks, documents, finance, inbox)
Give freelancers clear financial and operational visibility (dashboard metrics, cashflow, project progress)
Enable simple CRUD management for projects, tasks, clients and transactions with straightforward UX and API hooks
Support authenticated user sessions and per-user settings to keep data private and exportable

features.name: Auth
features.description: Sign in and account management to secure user access to the application.
user_flows: VIEW /auth -> Receive 200 with sign-in / sign-up page -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET / with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 dashboard view
VIEW /auth -> Receive 200 with sign-in / sign-up page -> POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with error message -> GET /auth -> Receive 200 sign-in page showing error

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Consolidated operational overview showing projects, tasks, clients and financial indicators.
user_flows: GET / with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with dashboard view (requires auth) -> GET /api/dashboard/metrics with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with metrics JSON (projects, tasks, revenue)
GET / without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized / redirect to /auth -> GET /auth -> Receive 200 sign-in page

features.name: Project Management
features.description: Create, read, update and view project details and project lists.
user_flows: POST /api/projects with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload {name, client_id, value, due_date} -> Receive 201 with created project id -> GET /projetos with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 list including created project -> GET /projetos/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 project details
POST /api/projects with Authorization: Bearer <token> and incomplete payload (missing name) -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/projects with same payload corrected -> Receive 201 created

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Task tracking and kanban-style board for organizing work per project.
user_flows: POST /api/tasks with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload {project_id, title, status} -> Receive 201 created task -> GET /tarefas with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 tasks list including new task -> PATCH /api/tasks/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload {status: "in_progress"} -> Receive 200 updated task
PATCH /api/tasks/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid status value -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/tasks/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 unchanged task

features.name: Financial Management
features.description: Record revenues and expenses and view financial dashboards and reports.
user_flows: GET /financeiro with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 financial dashboard view -> POST /api/finance/transactions with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload {project_id, type: "revenue", amount, date} -> Receive 201 transaction created -> GET /api/finance/report?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 report JSON

POST /api/finance/transactions with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload {project_id, type: "expense", amount: -1000} -> Receive 422 invalid amount -> GET /financeiro with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 dashboard unchanged

features.name: Inbox (Caixa de Entrada)
features.description: Capture ideas, references and incoming items to later convert into tasks or projects.
user_flows: GET /caixa-entrada with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 inbox view -> POST /api/inbox with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload {title, content, source} -> Receive 201 inbox item created -> POST /api/inbox/:id/convert-to-task with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload {project_id, assignee_id} -> Receive 201 task created
POST /api/inbox with Authorization: Bearer <token> and empty content -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /caixa-entrada with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 inbox view with form error

features.name: Client Management
features.description: Manage client directory, view client profiles and associated projects and financial metrics.
user_flows: GET /clientes with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 clients list -> POST /api/clients with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload {name, contact, company} -> Receive 201 client created -> GET /clientes/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 client profile with projects summary

POST /api/clients with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload that duplicates existing unique identifier -> Receive 409 conflict -> GET /clientes with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 list without duplicate

features.name: Settings
features.description: User and application configuration (profile, company data, preferences).
user_flows: GET /configuracoes with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 settings view -> PATCH /api/settings with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload {email_notifications: true, company_name} -> Receive 200 updated settings -> GET /configuracoes with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 settings reflecting changes

PATCH /api/settings with Authorization: Bearer <token> and payload {email: "invalid-email"} -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /configuracoes with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 showing previous valid settings
